In conserved/stable coordinates, the analytic implicit-function theorem and Hurwitz continuity establish a local equilibrium graph and exponential convergence. High-threshold counts give the closed spectrum and the exact two-issue invariant. A direct-rate checker passed 453 rational eigenmode/parity assertions on two through five issues; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The motivating paper classified neutral and attracting symmetry types numerically only for small issue counts, leaving exact analytic diagnostic rules and decay rates for arbitrarily many issues unavailable in its main text. The theorem supplies a complete, computationally finite parity criterion for conserved correlation observables, proves that neutral tangent directions are exact nonlinear invariants rather than merely undamped linear modes, and characterizes the local stable equilibrium fiber. The sharp two-versus-three-issue high-similarity separation and rate bottleneck provide motivated, testable structural distinctions. This is more than rewriting existing eigenvalue numerics or a normalization check.
